Respondent :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Appellant :- Anuj Kumar Srivastava,Gaurav Vinayam

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Learned A.G.A. submits that notice has been served on the informant.
Heard learned counsel for the appellant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the entire record.

This criminal appeal under Section 14-A (2) Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act has been preferred by the appellant with the prayer to set aside the bail rejection order dated 27.10.2023 passed by the learned Special Judge (SC/ST Act), Kanpur Nagar.

sentences.text: 1 It is submitted that in this case the allegation made in F.I.R. is totally false.

Further submitted that initially the present F.I.R. was lodged by the victim herself u/s 354, 354D, 427, & 506 I.P.C. in which there was no any allegation that rape was committed either with the victim or with her sister by the appellant but it was only to the extent of chasing her and making pressure on her to establish physical relation and also for threatening her to kill.
It is also submitted that she refused to undergo medical examination which shows that no any injury was caused by the appellant to the victim.

Further submitted that statement of the victim and her sister was recorded before the learned Magistrate u/s 164 Cr.P.C. in which after making improvement she stated that rape was also committed with her on the pretext of marriage for a period of 3-4 years and the appellant also made pressure on her to marry.
Likewise the statement of the victim was also recorded u/s 164 Cr.P.C. in which she stated that appellant was in live in relationship with the victim for a period of five years.

On the date of occurrence the appellant entered into the house of the victim and molested her sister but no any allegation of rape was made against him by the victim which shows that the allegations made in F.I.R. and the statements as recorded are totally false.
There is no any other material on record to show the complicity of the appellant.
Alleged offences are not attracted against him.
No specific role has been assigned to the appellant.
Offence under Section 376 I.P.C. is also not made out.
Entire allegations levelled in the F.I.R. and in the statement are false.
The Court below while passing the impugned order did not take into account the facts and evidence available on record in right perspective and erred in passing the same.
Learned counsel for the appellant also referred to the amended provisions of SC/ST Act.
Appellant is in jail since 30.09.2023 having no criminal antecedent.
It is lastly submitted that the impugned order rejecting the bail application of the appellant suffers from infirmity and illegality warranting interference by this Court.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as aforesaid.
I have considered the rival submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties and have gone through the entire record including the impugned order carefully.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, the allegation in F.I.R. and statement u/s 164 Cr.P.C., the Court is of the opinion that the appellant has made out a case for bail.
The Court below erred in rejecting the bail application.
The impugned order dated 27.10.2023 suffers from infirmity and illegality and the same is liable to be set-aside and the appeal is to be allowed.
Accordingly, the appeal is allowed and the impugned order rejecting the bail application of the appellant is set-aside.

Let the appellant- Akash Chaurasia involved in Case Crime No.512 of 2023, under Sections 354, 427,
506, 354D, 376(2)(n), 323, 504 I.P.C. and u/s 3(2)(5), 3(2)(5)ka, 3(1) Da & Dha of SC/ST Act, Police Station Chakeri, District Kanpur Nagar be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two heavy sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.

4. The appellant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.
